༄༅/ /khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i chog khrigs ngag 'don du bkod pa rdo rje'i grong du 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i chog khrigs ngag 'don du bkod pa rdo rje'i grong du 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir sngon 'gro'i chog khrigs khyer bde ba zhig bgod par byas te/ de yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nam phyi thun tha ma skya rengs dang po btang tsam phyi tshod na bde ba'i stan la lus drang por bsrangs/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal dbyangs gsal lan gsum bzlas pas ngag dag par byas te/ rig pa dwangs sing nger byas nas thun mong gi sngon 'gro la bzhi yod pa las/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' gsal btab pa ni/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di pa phan pa ma sgrub na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor pa ga la gyur// gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa ni/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs// 'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu lta bur myur mgyogs 'gro// gsum pa las rgyu 'bras ni/ dus kyis bsnyen nas rgyal po 'gro ba'i tshe// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu de ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// bzhi ba 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin// zhes ngag tu brjod cing don yid dang 'dre nges bsgom par bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la bzhi yod pa'i dang po rgyu snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar laṃ las rin chen gzhi// dag pa'i zhing khams rgya khyon chen po'i dkyil// paṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dkar zhing dwangs// de dbus dpag bsam shing chen rab rgyas pa/

rtsa ba gser la sdong po bai ḍūr+ya// lo 'dab rin chen sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i steng*// rdo rje rin chen las grub seng ge'i khri// lhab lhub dar gyis klubs pa'i gdan stengs su// pad+ma'i snying po nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khar// rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang dbang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// mtshan dpe'i rgyan rdzogs gzi byin rab 'bar ba// lham mer gsal ba rang la dgyes 'dzum bcas// ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs pa yi// mtha' bskor brgyud pa'i bla ma khrom tshogs tshul// mdun du yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa la// rab 'byams rgyud sde'i lha tshogs mang pos bskor// g.yas su bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po la// bde bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor// rgyab tu yum chen shes rab phar phyin la// dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam mang pos bskor// g.yon du 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang la// byang sems dgra bcom chen po'i tshogs kyi bskor// mtha' bskor phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad du// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// mkha' la sprin phung 'thibs bzhin bzhugs par gyur// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la = /bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la = /bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sems can thams cad kyi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos lam du longs par = /lam 'khrul sel bar = /'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar = /rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mched grogs chos mdzad dang bcas pa rnams la /snod kyi 'jig rten dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la= /bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo'i tshogs la= /snang srid dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la =

/rtogs pa'i bdag grol bar byin gyis bslab tu gsol// thugs rje gzhan grol bar = /rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par= /'brel tshad don dang ldan par= /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor chogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob par// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams skyabs pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'i// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la = /tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs/ phyir mi ldog la = /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la = /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la = /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la = /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la = /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// mgon po khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags// phyin chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyed kyi bslab bya rjes su slob// khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas// kun nas yongs su skyab tu gsol// lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yin ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

lan gsum*/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i blos// spro ba'i snyim pa dang bcas pas// rab tu btud de gus phyag 'tshal// dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul// phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa// mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun// rnam pa kun tu mchod par 'bul// thog med dus nas bsags pa yi// thun mong khyad par dang 'gal ba'i// mi dge bcu sogs nyes pa'i tshogs// ma lus 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags// nam mkha'i mthar thug phyogs kun tu// 'gro la phan par mdzad pa yi// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// dga' ba'i sems kyis rjes yi rang*// sna tshogs tshul gyi gdul bya la// rang rang bsam pa ji lta bar// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// theg mchog chos 'khor bskor du gsol// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las ni// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// ji srid 'khor ba de srid du// myang ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gzhan kun gyis bsags pa yi// dus gsum dge ba gcig bsdus nas// mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub snying po thob phyir bsngo// nam mkha'i dbyings rnams kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin rgyas pas khyab pa'i snying po nor bu'i khor yug gi /nang na zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sa gzhi rin chen las grub rim gyis gzhol ba bkod legs ma lus bkod pa'i phul gyis 'jig rten khams re re'ang 'dod yon rmad byung 'phyur ba gang*// mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing gis bskor zhing kun bzang mchod sprin ma tshang med pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i rdul rer rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa thams cad snang ba can// gcig tu 'du zhing so sor ma 'dres byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin de dag bdag gis dge ba'i sems kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// zhing khams rgya mtshor rdul rer rdul snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// kun gyis brgyan ldan ji snyed 'od 'phro'i rtser// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam mthar kun snang zhing*// 'khor zhi'i 'dod dgu ma tshang med 'dus pa// chos dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'phrul// nam mkha'i khams khyab srid pa'i mthar gnas nas// chos kyi rgyal po mchod pas mnyes gyur cig

/gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta yā mi// mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog / tshogs zhing bsdu/ dge ba bsngo'o/// /gnyis pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥ mgon po/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig

/gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ dge bsngo bya'o/// /gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dag pa'i zhing khams rgyan dang bkod pa mtsho'i sprin gyis mdzes par/ ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'i steng*/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar/ bdud dang log par 'dren pa thams cad zil gyis gnon zhing 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i brdar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khri'i steng du/ nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar pad+ma dang*/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i brdar zla ba dang*/ ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i brdar nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gcig tu 'dres pa'i brdar rtsa ba'i bla ma rig drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo/ chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i brdar sku mdog sngon po/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ stong pa nyid kyi gdangs bde bar shar ba'i brdar rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang mo sku mdog dmar mo la/ dga' ba'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar dga' ba'i rnam par 'gyur bas dgyes shing*/ rnam par rtog pa gcod pa dang bde ba skyong ba'i brdar gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs rdzogs pa'i brdar phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ yon tan ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu gsal bar rdzogs pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i brdar gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan zhing*/

thugs ji lta ba rtogs shing ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brdar dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa can du bzhugs kar gyur/ de'i mtha' bskor du dus gsum gyi bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun du glang po ches bteg pa'i khri pad nyi'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor rtas bteg pa'i khri pad zla'i gdan la/ rgyal pa shākya thub pa la dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ nub tu rma byas bteg pa'i pad zla'i gdan la/ yum chen mo la lung rtogs chos kyis bskor ba/ byang du shang shang gis bteg pa'i khri pad zla'i gdan la/ spyan ras gzigs sha theg pa che 'bring chung gsum gyi dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ mtha' bskor du chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bzhugs par gyur/ yan lag bdun las dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seṅge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du/ zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi bzad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyings kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad gis bstod// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhu me āḥhūṃ/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/

shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar du lus dang lus 'phags/ lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ nyi ma zla ba dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gu ru i dam maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/

spro na nam mkha'i dbyings rnams sku gsum yongs rdzogs sogs kyang dbul bar bya'o// mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khril zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /me tog dam pa 'phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan nams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ rgyas par spro na byang chub ltung bshags/ rtsa ltung bshags pa/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyang bya zhing*/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// bzhi pa rjes su yi rangs ba'i yan lag ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su yi rang*// lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes*// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba ni/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gi thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi//

bdun pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi/ chos rje sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha yi tshogs// skyabs gnas dam pa dkon mchog gsum po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal dad pas skyabs su mchi// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /rdo rje 'chang sogs dkar brgyud bla ma dang*// bla ma khyed thugs 'od gsal mnyam nyid du// dbyer med chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig pa'i// dkar brgyud kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// zhi khro yab yum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs// mos pa bzhin du tha dad der snang nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// yi dam kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// zab cing mtha' yas chos rnams kun gyi mdzod// rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams 'dus pa'i dpyid// dkon mchog gsum 'dus bla ma rin po che// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= dpal ldan bla ma dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// rkyen dang bar chad mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// byin rlabs stobs kyis ma spangs rang sar dag /chos skyong rgyal po bla ma rin po che// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /'di dang phyi ma dus rnams thams cad du// skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas// bla ma'i mos gus gcig pos chog pa yi// gcig chog rgyal po bla ma rin po che// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag sogs snying khar pad+mo'i ze'u 'bru la// 'bral ba med par rtag par bzhugs nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla ma sangs rgyas=

/chos rje sangs rgyas= /tshad bzung med pa'i thugs rje chen po yis// 'bral ba med par rtag par rjes bzung nas// khyed kyi bka' drin chen pos legs bskyangs te// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /bdag dang slob ma brgyud par bcas pa yi// gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu brgyud thams cad kyis// bla ma khyed kyi rnam thar 'khyongs pa dang*// don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan bla ma dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med pa ru// gus pa'i sgo nas zhabs gnyis spyi bor len// ci gsung bsgrubs pas thugs dgongs rdzogs byas nas// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la// skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing*// ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis// bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la 'jug par shog /bla ma sangs rgyas= /chos rje sangs rgyas= /bla ma sku khams bzang por gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gsol ba 'debs// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs// bla ma dang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi// chos rje sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi// spro na ma lus kun khyab ma sogs kyang bya'o// ma nam bzhi skor ci rigs dang bla ma ngo bo nyid sku'i gsol 'debs gang mang byas nas tshogs zhing g.yas bskor gyis bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstim/ de rang la bstim nas gnyis med kyi ngang du bzhag go /bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ oṃ swabhā wa shud+dharmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho?&haṃ/ rang nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las/

rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i 'od ltar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar bas rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu lus pa gcod cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshims par mdzad pa// mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhabs g.yas skum g.yon rkyang bas srog bral ba'i snying ga mnan te ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar gyad dang seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dar gyis klubs pa/ pad+ma zla nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rigs drug pa khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen dang tha mi dad par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas yar/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ de thams cad ngo bo chos nyid dag pa'i klong du gcig pa/ rnam pa gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs kyi skur shar bas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nas rdo rje 'chang la thugs gi bar dgongs pa la mtho dma' dang thugs rje la bri gang med pa sangs rgyas nyag gcig tu bzhugs par gyur// phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ na mo mahā mu dra ya/ sku gsum gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i sa// gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang du// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la sogs ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// byin rlabs kyi chu bo 'bab pa'i sa// shar za hor nor bu'i dgon pa ru// til+li shes rab bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i sa// byang puṣ+pa ha ri'i dgon pa ru// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyi rlobs// man ngag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i sa// lho gro bo lung gi dgon pa ru// sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsa la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// sgrub brgyud kyi gangs ri chags ka'i sa// nub la phyi gangs kyi ra ba ru// dbang phyug mi la ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// dkar brgyud kyi ri dbang brtan pa'i sa// shar dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa ru// chos rgyal dwags po lha rje la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// khams gsum gyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i sa// dpal phag mo gru yi nags khrod du// bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa skyong ba'i sa// sna phu chos lung gi dgon pa ru// grub thob gling chen ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes=

/lam gang shar= /snang srid sku gsum = /bshad sgrub kyi snying po len pa'i sa// 'brug ra lung gnyis kyi gdan sa ru// 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras la = /sems= /lam gang = /snang srid= /chos brgyad la ro snyoms byed pa'i sa// stag ri gangs kyi ra ba ru= /sangs rgyas dbon chen ras pa la// lhun grub kyi 'dzin pa'i sa// gdan sa ya bzhi'i bzhugs gnas su// chos rje gzhon nu seṅge la= /bde chen gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i sa// yang dgon rgyal po'i pho brang du// byang sems nyi ma seṅge la= /skye med kyi 'phangs spyod pa'i sa// bar 'brog rdor gling gi dgon pa ru// chos rje rdo rje gling pa la= /zab rgyas kyi chos sgo 'byed pa'i sa// spos skya dpal gyi gzims khang du// mtshan ldan spos skya pa chen po la= /theg chen gyi bstan pa dar ba'i sa// dkar brgyud kyi gdan khri yangs pa ru// drin can bcu gsum pa chen po la= /smin grol gyis skal ldan tshims pa'i sa// zab yangs bde chen gyi phug pa ru// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seṅge la = /bslab gsum gyi me tog 'khrungs pa'i sa// gzhan phan gyi skyed tshal yangs pa ru// drin can badz+ra rat+na la = /'khrul med kyi nyams myong 'char ba'i sa// zab gsal gyi kun dga' ra ba ru// 'jam dbyangs blo gros seṅge la = /gnas lugs kyi rang 'od gsal ba'i sa// gangs chen gyi lte ba gangs bzangs su// mnyam med mkhyen brtse'i rtogs ldan la = /'khor 'das la mnyam par spyod pa'i sa// rang byung lhan skyes kyi pho brang du// 'jam dbyangs ye shes rin chen la = /bdag gyi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i sa// mnyam nyid kyi zhing khams yangs pa ru// grub chen blo gros mchog ldan la = /skal ldan gyi sems rgyud grol ba'i sa// rang rig ye shes kyi pho brang du// drin can shes rab bzang po la = /mkhyen gnyis kyi lo tog rgyas pa'i sa// rang bzhin rnam dag gi pho brang du// 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la =

/snang grags rnams chos skur rol pa'i sa// phyogs bral gyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru// mtshungs med rgyal dbang chos rje la = /sems nyid kyi gter kha 'byed pa'i sa// stong nyid snying rje'i pho brang du// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la = /bde stong la rgyun chad med pa'i sa// gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga ru// yongs 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug la = /tshad med kyi thugs rjes khyab pa'i sa// 'phrin las mtha' rgyas kyi pho brang du// kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu la = /'khor 'das kyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i sa// snang srid dbang 'dus kyi pho brang du// mi pham chos kyi rgyal po la = /'dir snang rnams chos skur 'char ba'i sa// gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi pho brang du// khyab bdag bstan pa'i nyi ma la = /'khor 'das rnams chos skur rtogs ka'i sa// mnyam nyid ye shes kyi pho brang du// mkhas grub lha dbang blo gros la = /ma rungs pa'i klad pa 'gems pa'i sa// thim yul gyi bdud 'dul pho brang du// ngag dbang bdud 'joms rdo rje la = /chos brgyad rnams mkha' ltar dag pa'i sa// snang sems dbyer med kyi pho brang du// mkhan chen bsod nams 'od zer la = /byin rlabs kyi sprin phung 'phro ba'i sa// sku gsum rnam dag gi pho brang du// mtshungs med ngag dbang rgyal mtshan la = /rnam mkhyen gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i sa// gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo ru// 'dren mchog shākya rin chen la = /'khor 'das kyi rgya mdud zhig pa'i sa// gnas zab yangs mdo sde'i brag skyibs su// ngag dbang yon tan mtha' yas la = /chos brgyad kyi rdzun phug brdibs pa'i sa// gnyug ma'i dran rig gi lding khang du// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan la = /brtan mkhas kyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i sa// bslab gsum rnam dag gi pho brang du// 'jam dpal mthong thos la dge legs stor ba'i sa// tshad med thugs rje yi pho brang du// mthu chen 'jigs med chos rgyal la =

/ zhes pa'i bar ram yang na kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i rjes thog kho nar/ ris med kyi gdul bya skyong ba'i sa// gnas gar bzhugs don gyi 'og min du// grub dbang shākya shrī la = / gang ltar yang de'i 'phror/ grub rigs kyis nags khrod 'gengs pa'i sa// shar bde chen grub pa'i bsti gnas su// khyab bdag bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la = /tshe gcig la sangs rgyas ster ba'i sa// gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan stengs su// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma 'og ma 'og ma'i gdungs shugs kyis gong ma gong ma rim pa bzhin 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par gyur// de nas skabs 'dir spro na rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang bya ste/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// yon tan rin chen dpag tu med pa'i gter// rgya che rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las can// chos rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing*// myang 'das dman pa'i g.yang sa rab spangs te// bla med byang chub mchog la sbyor mdzad pa'i// chos rje = /skal dman sems can 'dul ba'i don gyi phyir// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus nas// tha mal tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa'i// chos rje = /bde gshegs mang pos bsgral bar ma nus ba'i// dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can mang po rnams// rgal dka' 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol mdzad pa'i// chos rje = /gang zhig gus pa chen pos nyer bsten na// gnas skabs mthar thug dgos ma lus pa// 'bad rtsol med pa myur du stsol mdzad pa'i// chos rje = /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub sgrub nas// don chen yal bar shor ba'i snying med po// dal 'byor mi lus stong log byed nyen gda'o// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i gdengs med kyang*// gtan du sdod grabs byed pa'i ngang ring po// 'chi khar brang lag 'thab mo 'chor nyen gda'o// 'chi ba rje su dran par byin gyis =

/da lta'i sdug bsngal phra mo mi bzod kyang*// las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i snying khams can// 'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'chor nyen gda'o// nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar= /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthong thos dran gyur kyang*// ba spu g.yo 'gul med pa'i snying ring po// rang gzhan don gnyis re thag chad nyen gda'o// byams dang snying rje 'byongs par = /gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong bar khas blangs nas// dgra la sdug las thong ba'i pho rgod po// rang gi sdom gsum yul nas 'don nyen gda'o// gnod sems rtsad nas thon par = /dge sbyor chos bzhi sgrub par dam par bcas nas// kha drag dbang che 'dod pa'i nga rgyal can// khas blangs thog tu 'khel bar mi gda'o// rtag tu dman cha 'dzin par = /'gro kun phan bde sgrub par khas blangs nas// gzhan gyi 'byor la khro ba'i phrag dog can// khas len che la nyams len chung bar gda'o// gzhan bde dga' ba skye bar = /bdag bas gzhan gces sgom par khas blangs nas// gnod len gnod pas 'jal ba'i zhe bzhag can// rang gzhan gnyis phung las la 'jug nyen gda'o// gnod len phan pa sgrub par = /cir snang bden pa med ces tshig smra yang*// bstod smad tsam la dga' dang mi dga' skye// nyams len phyogs tsam 'grub par mi gda'o// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par = /thog med dus kyi drin can pha ma rnams// bzod dka'i sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs gyur kyang*// bdag la skyob pa'i nus pa mi gda'o// mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed kyis thugs rjes zungs// tsha bas gdungs tshe bsil byed drin can rnams// dmyal me bzod dkas yun ring bsregs gyur kyang*// blun po bdag gis cung zad skyob ma nus// de dag myur du skyobs shig thugs rje can// lus kyi drod kyis bdag lus bskyangs pa'i ma// grang bas nyen nas sha rus gas gyur kyang*// bdag gis cung zad skyabs par ma nus pas// de dag myur du skyobs shig thugs rje can// yang yang nu zhos skyong byed ma rnams kyis// lo brgyar zas skom rnyed par ma gyur kyang*// chu thigs tsam yang sbyin par ma nus so// de dag myur du skyobs shig thugs rje can// gcig la gcig za mi sdug phrad pa dang*// sdug dang bral dang skye ga na 'chi sogs// sdug bsngal mang pos nyam thag 'gro ba rnams// myur du skyobs shig tshad med thugs rje can// srid pa'i btson rar sdug bsngal mang pos gzir// las da nyon mongs 'chir ba dam pos bcings// mgon skyabs med pa'i 'gro ba 'di rnams kyi// mgon skyabs mdzod cig tshad med thugs rje can//

zhes gdung ba drag pos gsol ba btab bo// de nas dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa dang bstun// mtshan rnams yongs rdzogs bla ma'i sku// mgrin par ngag gi thig le la// zhugs nas bum dbang dga' ba'i chus// sad pa'i dri ma sbyang du gsol// longs spyod rdzogs pa kun gyi skad// mgrin par ngag gi thig le la// zhugs nas gsang dbang mchog dga'i mes// rmi lam bag chags sreg tu gsol// dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi sku// snying khar sems kyi thig le la// zhugs nas shes rab ye shes nyis// gnyis 'thug mun pa sel du gsol// mgon po lhan cig skyais pa'i sku// lte bar ye shes thig le la// zhugs nas bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas// 'pho med thob par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar bdag dang 'gro rnams kyi// lus ngag yid dang ye shes tshogs// rdo rje bzhi dang mnyam sbyor bas// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug thob par shog /mthar bla ma gdan khri dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur// zhes bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i ngang la lhod kyis glod la bzhag go /mthar dge ba bsngo/ smon lam rgya cher gdab par bya'o// zhes pa 'ding shākya'i dge slong shākya rin chen dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis bsdebs pa dge'o//
